name: Switchboard
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: ONE original, exceptionally polished desktop portfolio WEBSITE screenshot, landscape 1536x1024, full viewport edge-to-edge. Render as a flat screen capture of the webpage, not a laptop, browser frame, presentation slide, or full-page phone layout.
Subject: Zohaib Haider, Full-Stack AI Software Engineer.
Required projects, exactly these FOUR: 'OpsPilot' / 'AI platform'; 'HR Intelligence' / 'AI-powered HR'; 'DSP' / 'Bookings + Stripe payments'; 'RTA' / 'Full-stack platform'. RTA's industry is unconfirmed: do not invent it. Screens are abstract illustrative previews, no fabricated revenue, performance claims, clients or testimonials. Include small readable capability text 'AI / LLM integrations', 'Payments & accounting APIs', and experience text 'Jidat IT / Full-stack development'. Name and role must be easy to find.
Critical change of style: the user rejected portrait-and-chrome portfolio designs. There must be NO PHOTO, NO PORTRAIT, NO HUMAN, NO AVATAR, NO giant serif headlines, NO italic serif fonts, NO chrome, NO metal ribbons, NO translucent glass screens, NO black-and-gold luxury, NO aubergine, NO cobalt-and-chrome, NO AI brains, NO generic neon spheres, NO predictable two-column left-headline right-image hero, NO repetitive four-card bento template. Use beautiful contemporary sans-serif typography, precise alignment, confident hierarchy, and unusual but usable composition. Make software work and navigation central. This is a visually designed portfolio, not just an infographic.
Art direction SWITCHBOARD: tactile playful precision, a contemporary creative engineer's interactive instrument. Cream #F4F1EA, ink #252722, saturated persimmon #F36A3D, soft sky blue #AACBE8, sage #AFC3A0. Matte painted surfaces, rubber controls, papery labels, very subtle realistic shadows. Lively yet mature, impeccable rounded neo-grotesk typography like a refined Satoshi/Geist mix, no childish toy look.
Composition:
- Thin cream top masthead: 'zohaib haider' in a beautiful medium-weight lowercase wordmark left; center 'full-stack / ai engineer'; right 'work / experience / contact ↗'. Quiet human tone, no photo.
- Upper 15% centered compact headline 'Ideas in. / Useful software out.' using tight clean sans-serif 64px, visually integrated with tiny orange flow markers. Short line 'AI products, payment workflows, and the systems connecting them.' Small enough to leave actual work central.
- Central 60% ONE large exquisitely designed pale cream recessed instrument surface spans almost full width, in subtle axonometric perspective, with precision controls and FOUR DIFFERENT named project mechanisms arranged across the whole surface, varying visual rhythm rather than equal cards. No laptop or monitor mockups. Mechanism 1 OpsPilot: a persimmon wide square module with a small beautiful flat embedded AI workflow UI, tiny luminous cream dots travelling between input, model, tool, output; a tactile black scroll wheel on the edge. Mechanism 2 HR Intelligence: a tall sky-blue module with a small clean flat HR interface display, three neatly aligned soft tab pieces and a springy lever, 'AI-powered HR'. Mechanism 3 DSP: a compact sage section with a flat booking calendar and payment approval stamp graphic, a single orange status toggle, labeled 'Bookings + Stripe payments'. Mechanism 4 RTA: cream and ink modular blocks with a folded orange corner and clean generic interface preview, labeled 'Full-stack platform'. Every mechanism is a distinct composition but lives on the same instrument surface. Each exact title printed in crisp sans-serif beside its mechanism, tiny index 01/02/03/04 and 'Open project ↗'. Channels in the surface subtly connect the modules with thin orange lines. Spare negative space, careful industrial design. This is an interactive WEBSITE control surface, not a product photo of physical hardware.
- A narrow floating pill near lower-center 'PLAY WITH THE SYSTEM' with hand cursor icon, and small stable 'VIEW PROJECT INDEX ↗' text.
- Bottom 12% clean ruled offwhite strip: 'AI / LLM integrations' | 'Payments & accounting APIs' | 'Jidat IT / Full-stack development'. At lower-right a simple dark button 'Let’s build ↗'.
High-end tactile rendering and font taste, delightful details, warm welcoming energy, evidence of advanced UI interaction. No screen filled with fake hardware labels or illegible microscopic copy. Readable WEBSITE first, whimsical physical material second.

- Directly below, a very clean full-width title row 'Selected software' in 52px perfectly set sans-serif, '04 projects' small right, then a fine ink rule. Projects are immediately the main page content.
- The main 70% of viewport is FOUR enormous full-width indexed accordion ROWS, typography sized for legibility, each row divided by thin black rules. First OpsPilot row EXPANDED, occupying 44% of full viewport height, while others collapsed as 95px clean rows below.
- Expanded OpsPilot row: top line huge but controlled '01' in orange at left, 'OpsPilot' in clean 58px medium sans center-left, tiny 'AI PLATFORM' and a sharp 45-degree arrow at far right. Beneath this title line, a full-width integrated project canvas aligned flush to the row: an art-directed precise matte orange planar zigzag/folded surface runs through the LEFT TO RIGHT WIDTH, with a beautiful readable AI workflow interface in the central area. The workflow shows small simple ink/white panels 'Input', 'AI / LLM', 'Tool call', 'Output', sophisticated diagram typography, thin connector lines. One small matte physical orange cuboid and dark folded sheet offer restrained 3D depth but never dominate. A tasteful mini 'PROJECT PREVIEW' label makes it a design preview. Small readable caption beneath 'AI-powered workflows, presented through clear interfaces.' and action 'Explore project ↗'. This area is laid out as ONE full-width project story, not text-column on one side and art on the other.
- Row 2 '02' 'HR Intelligence' 'AI-POWERED HR' and arrow. Row 3 '03' 'DSP' 'BOOKINGS + STRIPE PAYMENTS' and arrow. Row 4 '04' 'RTA' 'FULL-STACK PLATFORM' and arrow. Each row has tiny distinctive graphic glyph at right, no thumbnail cards.
- At bottom a clean deep charcoal strip with white small labels 'AI / LLM integrations', 'Payments & accounting APIs', 'Jidat IT / Full-stack development', and bright orange contact dot.
The outstanding design comes from beautiful exact type, interaction affordances, generous whitespace, fine rules, dramatic expanded/collapsed rhythm, and a singular sculptural ORANGE matte paper element. No shiny materials, no unnecessary giant marketing slogan, no visual clutter, no old portrait style. This is a practical stylish portfolio with a genuinely different browsing model.

Modern friendly HUMANIST SANS-SERIF only, beautifully set 48px headline max, tiny monospace map labels. No serif fonts. Handmade physical texture, diffused daylight, deeply considered soft contact shadows, refined and adult.

- A gorgeous asymmetrical three-dimensional PAPER TERRAIN across the WHOLE WIDTH of the central 70% screen. Not an island game, no water, no room, no office, no people. A collection of FOUR architectural paper pavilions connected by delicate scored pathways on a continuous folded-paper landscape. The page feels like an exquisite interactive art object, yet every project is easy to find and open. Strong airy composition, asymmetry, exceptional physical paper rendering.
